title: Example analysis
text: far, GHE supervised 154 projects 42 done BSc 112 MSc students.  next chart shows type projects supervised. Bachelor’s students exclusively theses, Master’s students semester projects theses, latter represented frequently.  number students risen steadily years, number Bachelor’s students doubling 2023 2024. number Master’s students risen slowly comparison, still significantly higher absolute numbers.  Finally, word cloud shows frequently used terms thesis titles. larger font, frequently term used. noted terms reduced stems (e.g. ‘design’, ‘designing’, ‘designed’ become ‘design’).
